book.name: Macho
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Macho gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Jiso fɛ muh wù kwe wa kimbe kimimia
Jiso lee a ŋguh le, wu kaasɛ wu daŋ wu gɛɛŋ a kilaantɛŋ ke le.

Fi kooshɛ lɛ bamii bamu gɛ̀ too bɛ muh mu fɛ wu le a wu kwe wa kimbe kimimia, bo tuu a kidaŋ le. Jiso yɛŋ lɛ bamii bayu le bo leesɛ muntele muboo ye ye le, wu jɛmɛ muh wù gɛ̀ kwe kimbe kimimia wɛɛ le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsaa yaŋ, jijɛ fitele le. Nle nlɛɛshɛ wa bimbefɛ biuŋ.”

content: Fi kooshɛ lɛ bamii bamu ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo gɛ̀ kɛ bo tu bo shuŋshi lɛbolɛbo bo duu lɛ, “Muh wunɛ jode kijusɛ ki Nyo.”
Jiso kɛɛ baŋkwajɛ baboo wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kɛme baŋkwajɛ ba befe a muntele mwɛna le nɛ nje la?
Fi chige fì njɛmɛ le fì la? Ki njɛmɛ muh wunɛ le lɛ nle nlɛɛshɛ wa bimbefɛ bie noo, lɛ wu jâ we wu jîɛnyi le?
Geenɛ, nlé ŋgê bɛŋ kɛ̂ɛ lɛ muh wu jee che le Mwamuh kɛme bvuŋga fɛkuu fɛnɛ ki wu lɛ̂ɛshɛ bimbefɛ.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo wu mo wu du muh wù gɛ̀ kwe kimbe kimimia wɛɛ le lɛ,

content.text: “Ja we, wo jo bvuko bwuŋ wo gɛ̂ɛne fɛ yeh le.”

content: Wu mo wu ja we wu gɛɛne fɛ yeh le.
Kinchvu ki bamii yɛŋ fiɛɛ fì kooshi le, nfaaŋ koo bo, bo tu bo tume maŋkuŋ ma Nyo wù le wu nya kfuu chi bvunɛ bvuŋga muh wu wuŋ le.
Jiso tɛɛŋ Macho
Jiso gɛ̀ ja fo wu doo wu jiɛnyi wu gɛɛne wu yɛŋ muh mu le ba tɛŋe lɛ Macho, nyu muh wù gɛ̀ koode ŋwa, wu shii fɛ kijusɛ ke ki lɛme le. Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,
Wu mo wu ja we wu bii wu le.
Jiso gɛ̀ ja wu gɛɛŋ wu shii wu jii mwɛɛ a Macho yeh, fi kooshɛ lɛ bamii bamu wesee ba gɛ̀ koode ŋwa, mo bamii ba befe bamu tɛ gɛ̀ to bo shii bo jii mwɛɛ bɛ ba Jiso mo booŋ be ba ŋgoo.
Bafalashii doo bo yɛŋ no bɛ bo jii mwɛɛ noo bo biih booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ, “Le nje la wù muh wene wu n'yɛyɛ jii mwɛɛ bɛ bamii ba koode ŋwa mo bamii ba befe bamu?”
Jiso yu no bo biide, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ bamii ba tɛɛme to bo goone muh wu nche gɛ. To goone nyu bamii ba chɛne.

Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ bɛŋ kwâjɛ, bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ laa kinyi ki fiɛɛ fì ba saŋ finɛ Nyo jɛme lɛ, ‘Ŋgoone lɛ bamii kôode nyu yii fɛ bamii le, gɛ ŋgoone lɛ bo gêe nyu kintanyɛ fɛ mɛne gɛ’, le lɛ la lɛ? Bɛŋ kêe lɛ gɛ nto ki ntɛɛŋ nyu bamii ba chaaŋ gɛ. Nto ki ntɛɛŋ nyume bamii ba befe.”

content: Bamii biih kune mbaŋ mwɛɛ munjile
Booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Joŋ gɛ̀ ja bo to bo biih Jiso le lɛ, “Le nje la wù besa Bafalashii banɛ mwɛɛ munjile, buŋ booŋ ba ŋgoo banɛ gɛ?”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kwaji lɛ taŋlo ba tɛɛŋ bamii ba bvuguu, bo gɛɛŋ bo nyu yii yii chiji bvuguu nyu bɛ bo? Geenɛ, aju too lo a ba lé ba fî chiji bvuguu wuyu a bo le, bo mo bo kɛ bo banɛ mwɛɛ munjile.

Gɛ muh taŋlo wu jo finchaŋa fi nju fifɛŋ, wu chvuushɛ nju yì kege yu gɛ. Nɛ wu ge lo noo, finchaŋa fi nju fiyu kfunyɛ fi saayɛ nju yì kege yiyu, kintuge kì le fo ki mɛsɛ ki kugɛ lo ki fe no ki chi shee ki nyume.

Gɛ taŋlo tɛ muh jo mbvuuŋ manfɛŋ wu gɛɛ a kolo wu mbvuuŋ wù kege le gɛ, wu ge lo noo, mbvuuŋ manfɛŋ maa ge mo koo, mo saayɛ lo kolo wù kege wɛɛ, mbvuuŋ bɛ kolo mo mu lɛsɛ achiji. Fi kooji le lɛ ba kɛme ki ba gɛɛ mbvuuŋ manfɛŋ nyume a kolo wù fwɛŋ le. Noo, mbvuuŋ bɛ kolo mo, mo nyume.”

content: Kwɛse wumu kuŋ Jiso le wu tɛmɛ,Jiso fɛ mwa muh wù baaŋ yɛmɛ

Gɛh no Jiso gɛ̀ baaŋ wu jɛme bo le noo, fi kooshɛ lɛ muh wù baaŋ wumu gɛ̀ to wu lee wu tuŋ anyuu a wu jii wu lɛgɛ lɛ, “Mwa yaŋ wù kwɛse le wu kwe gɛh mɛɛse nɛ, geenɛ, to wo kuŋ wu le bɛ kibo kuŋ wu kaasɛ wu tu yu.”
Jiso mo wu ja we bɛ wu tu bo gɛɛne, booŋ be ba ŋgoo bii tɛ wu le.
Fi kooshɛ lɛ kwɛse wumu wù gɛ̀ bee wu chɛŋ wa bɛ kinchɛŋ ki bikɛse lɛ biluŋ le yuufe ncho bifɛɛ gɛ̀ to a Jiso jiŋ wu kuŋ jwe wù nju ye le.
Fɛ wu kuŋ noo, gɛ̀ bee wu jɛmɛ wa fɛ fitele fie le lɛ, “Nɛ mɛ moŋ nlo ŋkuŋ gɛh nyu nju ye le, tu nle ntɛmɛ wa.”
No wu kuŋ noo, Jiso kaasɛ ye wu yɛŋ wu le, wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Mwa yaŋ, keefɛ wo fâane gɛ. Fitele fiuŋ fì wo lese yi ye yaŋ le, le fi ge wa wo tɛmɛ.”

content: Gɛh sege yu, kwɛse wuyu mo wu tɛmɛ lo.
Jiso gɛɛŋ wu fɛsɛ fɛ muh wù baaŋ wɛɛ yeh le, wu yɛŋ bamii ba gɛ̀ toŋe bandoŋ ba kwe mo kinchvu ki bamii. Ki gɛ̀ bee fo bo fuge lo bɛ kwe.
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ sâaŋe, mwa wuyu baaŋ a kwe gɛ, wu lefe lo.”

content: Bamii bayu tu bo keede lo wu.
Bo doo bo bvusɛ bamii bayu akfuuŋ, wu mo wu lee wu gɛɛŋ yeh, wu jijɛ mwa wuyu yi kibo le, wu mo wu ja we.
Saaka wù kune fiɛɛ fiyu jiɛnyɛ fi gɛɛŋ a kimbe ki woŋ wuyu le kichii.
Jiso gwenyɛ ajii a binfeeŋ bifɛɛ
Jiso ja fɛ yeh yɛɛ le, wu doo wu jiɛnyi wu gɛɛne, binfeeŋ bimi bifɛɛ, nyu bilɛŋsɛ bi kuŋe bi bii wu le bi wanɛ fɛwɛɛwe bi duu lɛ, “Mwa Nfoŋ Dabi, koo yii fɛ bee le.”
Jiso gɛɛŋ wu lee yeh, binfeeŋ biyu bi wu le, wu biih bi le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ le bɛŋ bɛɛŋ lɛ taŋlo ŋge fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ beede finɛ?”

content: Bi bɛɛŋ lɛ, “Ɛɛŋ Tada.”
Jiso mo wu kuŋ ajii aboo le wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bii yi fitele fì bɛŋ leese yi ye yaŋ le, fi ge ye noo fɛ bɛŋ le.”

content: Ajii aboo mo wo gwenyɛ. Jiso mo wu lejɛ lo fi tɛmɛ bo le wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ yɛ̂ne keefɛ bɛŋ môŋ bɛŋ gê muh kɛ̂ɛ gɛ.”

content: Geenɛ, bo ka bo gɛɛŋ bo saŋsɛ lo saaka kune lɛme chi Jiso kimbe ki woŋ wuyu le wuchii.
Jiso fɛ kinchifɛ
No bamii bayu gɛ̀ ja wa bo gɛɛne, fi kooshɛ lɛ bamii gɛ̀ ja bo to bɛ kinchifɛ kimi fɛ Jiso le, nchɛndaa wu debele nyu yi wu le.

Jiso doo wu bvusɛ nchɛndaa wu debele wuyu ye yi muh wuyu le, wu mo wu kɛ wu jɛme. Kinchvu ki bamii yɛŋ noo jwe yuŋ bo, bo tu bo maŋe bo duu lɛ, “Gɛ bo gɛ̀ yu wa bo yɛŋ fiɛɛ njɛ finɛ le woŋ wù Ishwala le gɛ.”
Geenɛ, Bafalashii jɛme fiboo lɛ, “Wu bvuuse banchɛndaa ba debele banɛ nyu bɛ bvuŋga bvu nfoŋ banchɛndaa ba debele.”
Ŋgwejɛ duude baaŋ bamii ba ŋgwejɛ nyu shige

Jiso ja wu jiɛnyi a bilaantɛŋ le bichii mo bantɛ le wu yɛyi bamii yéh yi buunɛ yiboo le, wu ka feeji tɛ saaka wù joŋe kune bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo. Wu gɛ̀ jiɛnyi noo wu fɛde tɛ binchɛŋ bichii mo goŋ yì baaŋ.
Wu gɛ̀ yɛŋ binchvu bi bamii le, yii koo wu bɛ bo nje bo gɛ̀ bee yi manluŋ le, muh nyume gɛ yu wù fii bo gɛ, njɛ shóŋ yì le gɛ bɛ muh wù chiɛɛne yi gɛ.
Wu mo wu ja wu jɛmɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Ŋgwejɛ duude baaŋ, geenɛ bamii ba ŋgwejɛ nyu shige.
Noo, bɛŋ bûune lɛ Tada wù Chiji mwɛ chiiŋsɛ bamii ba ŋgwejɛ a wu mwɛne.”
